title: Secondary Model Coverage Tests and Selective Acquisition
mission: Probe and selectively acquire only secondary sources with a plausible HKG mechanism while formally excluding irrelevant domains.
steps: Run HKO/marine coverage probes for nbmoc and nbmparoc.
Probe GDAS/CDAS analysis usefulness and exact variables.
Acquire small targeted GEFS chemistry aerosol subset for haze/radiation hypotheses.
Acquire targeted wave/sea-state variables only at marine points.
Evaluate CFS fields only as slow background features.
Write explicit no-query exclusions for every US-only product.
Promote a source to backfill only when coverage, variable relevance, retention and quota criteria pass.
tests: information redundancy screening without sealed outcomes
acceptance: Every listed secondary model has explicit acquire/probe/exclude result
failure: No coverage or no plausible mechanism: create rejection folder; do not force inclusion
